payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook reproduces Figure 1 from a scientific paper, focusing on climate reconstructions and simulations. It processes and visualizes data using various Python libraries, comparing ensemble means and reconstructions. The notebook imports data from multiple sources, processes it using pandas, and visualizes it with matplotlib. The outputs include processed data tables and visualizations of climate reconstructions and simulations.
